summary: Iteration 15 verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass on test_iteration15.py covering (a) brute-force lockout — 5x 401 then 6th 429 with 'locked … minute(s)' message; per-email scope (VICTIM2 still 401); locked email returns 429 even with the right password (lock window enforced upfront); successful login wipes the counter (4 fails → success → 4 more fails do NOT lock). (b) Salary auto-request — office_admin mark-paid on a student referencing Ravi Kumar (eligible_incentive=500) creates a pending expense_request with kind='salary', linked_student_id, amount=500, description containing 'Incentive payout · student NAME (ref: Ravi Kumar)'; idempotent (no duplicate on repeat call); unmark-paid deletes the pending request and clears incentive_paid; if request was already approved by super_admin (real transaction created), unmark-paid leaves the request intact (student.incentive_paid still flips back to false); super_admin's own mark-paid path does NOT auto-create a request. Unique index on login_attempts.email verified directly via index_information() → email_1 with 'unique': True. Frontend (Playwright): live perm refresh — logged in as blr1, then via separate admin curl session set clients=none, dispatched visibilitychange + focus events on the blr1 tab → nav-clients hid WITHOUT re-login. Route guard (/clients direct nav) — blr1 was redirected to / with toast 'You don't have access to this page anymore.'. Super_admin bypass — admin reached /clients with full sidebar intact (verified via screenshot). Toast text confirmed in source: 'Incentive marked paid · salary request sent for approval' on mark-paid, 'Marked unpaid · any pending salary request cancelled' on unmark-paid. State cleanup applied at end: all locktest+* and victim@finflow.com login_attempts deleted; blr1 perms reset to all-edit; blr1 students reset to incentive_paid=false.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_lib.check_lockout / record_failed_attempt / clear_failed_attempts are clean and idempotent. check_lockout fires BEFORE password verification — correct ordering, prevents timing/brute attacks during the lock window.
Lockout uses ISO timestamp string in Mongo (locked_until). datetime.fromisoformat works because the value is generated via datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta, preserving tz. Safe.
MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS=5 / LOCKOUT_MINUTES=15 are reasonable. Consider exposing as env vars for production tuning.

students.mark_incentive_paid resolves the referring staff by case-insensitive name match against db.clients (client_type='staff'). Fragile if two staff share a name, but acceptable given existing reference-by-name pattern elsewhere.

mark_incentive_paid only creates the expense_request when amount>0 AND role=='office_admin' — super_admin's own mark-paid path is correctly silent. Idempotency via the early-return-when-already-paid branch.

unmark_incentive_paid deletes ONLY the pending request via filter {status:'pending'}, so settled (approved/rejected) requests are preserved. The student doc still loses incentive_paid which is correct UX (you may re-trigger a new request if needed).
auth.jsx visibility/focus refresh has a guard: only fires when user is truthy (skip during initial check and unauth) — good. fetchMe is wrapped in useCallback so the dependency array is stable.
PermGate is clean: defers redirect until user is loaded; super_admin auto-passes via canView; toast fires inside useEffect to avoid render-loop. Wraps all sensitive routes in App.js.

Minor: server.py's startup index creation does not handle the case where login_attempts already contains duplicate emails — initial create_index('email', unique=True) would crash. Not an issue today but a one-shot dedupe before the index call would be safer.

Minor: PermGate redirects to '/' which is itself wrapped in PermGate(page='overview'). If a super-admin ever sets a user's overview=none they would hit an infinite redirect loop. Currently overview is locked-edit by convention but the guard does not enforce that contract.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (live-refresh + route guard + super-admin bypass all verified)
